CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 15, 2022

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:03 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Marlene
  Vega, Contract Assistant Planner; Alejandro Deloera, Contract Assistant
  Planner; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda items.

E.  RE-ORDER THE AGENDA:

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to reorder the Agenda to move Discussion Item 1 to after Public
  Hearings.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

 F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT AMD-22-01, ZONE CHANGE AMD-22-02
  AND LOT LINE ADJUSTMENT LOTA-22-01 (7:06 P.M.)
  • Story Park (APN: 5337-002-900), 301 North Story Place, 305
  North Story Place, 311 North Story Place, 317 North Story Place,
  323 North Story Place, 327 North Story Place
  • Request: This is an application for a Lot Line Adjustment, General
  Plan Amendment, Zone Change, and Lot Line Adjustment to transfer
  approximately 0.29 acres of land from Story Park to the six abutting
  residential properties to the east. The transfer will necessitate a
  General Plan Amendment to change the land use designation from
  Open Space to Low Density Residential and a Zone Change to
  change the Zoning classification from Open Space to R-1 (Single
  Family residential). Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality
  Act, an Initial Study and Negative Declaration have been prepared
  for the proposal.
  • Recommended Action: Continue to September 6, 2022.
  • Commissioner Sahu recused himself from the item.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the item to the September 6, 2022, Planning
  Commission meeting.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Sahu
  Absent:  None

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TTM-22-02 (7:10 P.M.)
  • 727 South Sierra Vista Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Tentative Tract Map TTM-22-
  02 that will facilitate the conversion of an approved, but not yet built,
  6,636 square foot, six (6) unit residential apartment complex into
  condominium units on a site of approximately 10,000 square feet
  located in the R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone, for the property
  located at 727 South Sierra Vista Avenue in the City of Alhambra.
  (This application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality
  Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-28 approving
  Tentative Tract Map TTM-22-02, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Contract Assistant Planner Marlene Vega provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • George Lee, the property owner; Hank Jong, the Applicant;
  Sheila Harjanto, the Civil Engineer; and David Lin, the
  2
  08/15/2022
   Architectural Designer, were available to answer questions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to recess for 15 minutes.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Mojarro.
  •  The motion carried by the following majority vote:

  Majority Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  •  Recess at 7:31 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 7:45 P.M.

  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Suhail Khalil
  3.) Liz E.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Tentative Tract Map TTM-22-02 with two (2) added
  conditions of approval: 1.) Applicant shall record a deed restriction or
  other covenant against the property in the Los Angeles County Registrar-
  Recorder Office in a form acceptable to the Director of Community
  Development and City Attorney that describes the above stated income
  restriction prior to receiving a Certificate of Occupancy; and 2.) Applicant
  shall pay all construction workers employed in the execution of the
  project at least the general prevailing rate of per diem wages for the type
  of work and geographic area, as determined by the Director of Industrial
  Relations pursuant to Sections 1773 and 1773.9 of the Labor Code, and,
  the Applicant shall also use skilled and trained workforce to complete the
  project. Applicant shall submit Prevailing Wage and Skilled and Trained
  Workforce Certification to the Community Development Department prior
  to the issuance of any Permits authorizing any work related to the project,
  including Permits to demolish any existing structures and any Permits to
  construct the project.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-2-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia
  Noes:  Mojarro, Gardea
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-02 & VARIANCE VAR-22-03
  (8:41 P.M.)

  3
  08/15/2022
   •  560 West Main Street, Suite B
  •  Request: This is a request for a Commercial Planned Development
  Permit and a Variance to allow a food service establishment to
  establish a boba tea shop in an existing lease space with less than
  the required parking located at 560 West Main Street Suite B in the
  CPD (Commercial Planned Development) zone. (This application is
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-29 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-02 and Variance VAR-22-03, subject to
  the Conditions of Approval.
  •  Contract Assistant Planner Alejandro De Loera provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  Steven Chen, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Suhail Khalil

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Planned Development Permit PD-22-02 & Variance
  VAR-22-03.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion caried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Recuse: None
  Absent:  None

G.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PRESENTATION SERIES ON THE COMPREHENSIVE ZONING CODE
  UPDATE (8:53 P.M.)
  • This is the second presentation in a series of presentations on the
  Comprehensive Zoning Code Update project presented by the
  Planning Division staff.
  • Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report and provide
  input to Staff as deemed appropriate.

  08/15/2022
   •  Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Suhail Khalil
  2.) Jennifer Ng
  3.) Bert Ng

  5.) Ari Gutierrez Arambula

H.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso gave an update on the Housing Element. Staff
  is working on revisions requested by HCD, and are following up on the submittal as
  they are close to getting the Housing Element certified. Once confirmation is received,
  the documents will be brought back for final adoption. (10:19 P.M.)

I.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Jennifer Ng commented that if the Commission adjourn to the next regularly
  scheduled meeting, they may lose the opportunity to meet on Monday, August 29th.
  She thanked the Commission for the work that they do. (10:21 P.M.)

  •  Helen Fong provided an update on her previous comments at the June 20th meeting
  regarding her HOA and noise on Main Street. Noise is coming from the mixed- use
  zone on Main Street, and impacts the residents. She is hoping for change to the
  CUP permit. (10:22 P.M.)
